falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,150 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level, invalidating the bottoming pattern thesis and suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-level volatility inconsistent with a bottoming formation; the August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 27.6 and rapidly declining, so this would signal a different regime (capitulation/escalation) rather than the expected stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The current pattern assumes rate relief as part of the bottoming context; yields above 4.75% would indicate renewed inflation/risk-premium fears or Fed hawkish repricing, destroying the disinflationary soft-landing narrative that supported the August 2024 bottom and this 80% pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
